chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abu Saeed al-Shami, from Salih ibn Uqba who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Feed Al-Barny (dates) to your womenfolk during their postpartum bleeding, your children would be forbearing.'

key_terms.الْبَرْنِيَّ: Al-Barny, a specific variety of dates recommended in Shia tradition

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended food for women during postpartum to benefit the child's character?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) recommends feeding 'Al-Barny' (a specific variety of date) to women during the postpartum period (nifas) to foster patience and forbearance in their children. This practice highlights the Shia tradition of linking specific dietary recommendations with spiritual and character development, emphasizing the mother's role in nurturing righteous offspring through both physical nourishment and divine blessing.
